channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Bulwark: Falconeer Chronicles
item.description: Bulwark blends casual and creative building elements with touches of strategy and exploration. It's an experimental mix of genres that can be enjoyed casually or as an epic conquest featuring naval units, air units, and fortresses.

item.title: Choo-Choo Charles
item.description: Navigate an open-world island in an old train, upgrade it over time, and use it to fight an evil spider train named Charles.

item.title: DAEMON X MACHINA
item.description: Pilot your fully customizable Arsenal mech and join your fellow mercenaries in defending humanity from the corrupted machines and gigantic robots in this post-apocalyptic action game!

item.title: He Who Watches
item.description: Walk on walls. Manipulate gravity. Discover secrets. In this first-person puzzle game, delve deep into an ancient labyrinth of intricate conundrums, seeking an imprisoned god at the centre.

item.title: Megastore: Tidy Up Together
item.description: Megastore: Tidy Up Together is a cozy sorting game for solo or online co-op play. Organize three stores of increasing scale: a Toy Store, a bustling Supermarket, and a massive two-story Megastore. Pick up, sort, and shelve thousands of items, and get ready to open!

item.title: Potionomics
item.description: You’ve inherited your uncle’s potion shop—and a huge debt. Better get brewing! Customize your store, hire heroes to gather ingredients, befriend (or romance) fellow vendors to learn new haggling strategies, and go head-to-head with competitors in this narrative-driven, deck-building shop simulator.

item.title: Rune Factory 3 Special
item.description: Bridge the divide of an ancient schism between humans and monsters in Rune Factory 3 Special as half-human, half-wooly protagonist Micah. Farm, fight and fall in love as you revisit a classic in the series that perfected the blend of RPG & Life-sim genres.

item.title: Rune Factory 4 Special
item.description: Journey to the vibrant world of Rune Factory and experience the legendary fantasy farming adventure like never before!

item.title: Rune Factory 5
item.description: As the newest ranger of a peacekeeping organization known as SEED, protect your community by rounding up rowdy monsters and going on special missions. Cultivate your farm and friendships alike while unravelling rune-related mysteries!

item.title: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma
item.description: Welcome to the eastern nation of Azuma! In this fresh take on Rune Factory, use your powers as an Earth Dancer to restore the land, its people, and even its gods. Along the way, battle corrupted monsters, rebuild seasonal farms and villages, and form bonds with the colorful locals.

item.title: STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar
item.description: Searching for a peaceful farm life, a fresh mountain breeze, and your own market stall? Look no further than the friendly community of Zephyr Town! Here you’ll grow crops and raise animals, get to know the locals, and sell your wares at the town's bazaar to restore it to its former glory.

item.title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel
item.description: At Thors Military Academy, Erebonia’s best learn everything from the art of war to liberal arts. First year Rean Schwarzer learns he’s been selected to join the controversial Class VII, and they’ll need to deal with more than just class warfare--they’ll need to safeguard their country from chaos.

item.title: BOMBANANA!
item.description: Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode?

item.title: ShipShaper: Falconeer Chronicles
item.description: ShipShaper is a creative game about the simple joy of designing ships. Nothing more. Nothing less. Export to Bulwark, 3D print, or use in your own games with a free commercial license.

item.title: Cognition Method
item.description: Cognition Method is a story-driven, first-person puzzle game inspired by 2001: A Space Odyssey and Solaris. Discover the innovative mechanics of altering gravity and dive into the surreal setting. Find your way within a mysterious artifact and unveil a non-ordinary story.

item.title: EVERSPACE™ 2 - Supporter Pack
item.description: The EVERSPACE 2 Supporter Pack opens up new cosmetic options for series megafans to customize ships.

item.title: EVERSPACE™ 2 - Titans
item.description: Dreadnought and Leviathan have arrived in Cluster 34. Titans brings new story and massive repeatable challenges to EVERSPACE 2. Discover two exciting storylines alongside a cast of new and returning characters!

item.title: Homicide Desk
item.description: Read the evidence. Run the forensics. Question suspects in your own words, they lie, crack, or lawyer up. Accuse the wrong person, and Internal Affairs comes after you.

item.title: Maestro's Cold War 2
item.description: Addictive yet chill. An immersive Cold War sandbox. Revive the Cold War in this classic strategy game—easy to pick up, yet challenging and deep, offering endless replayability.

item.title: Metal: Hellsinger
item.description: Slay to the rhythm of metal and vengeance on an infernal journey through the eight Hells. Make them fear the beat. Metal: Hellsinger is a rhythm FPS bursting with demons, badass weapons, and heavy metal music.

item.title: Tower! Simulator 3
item.description: The Gold Standard in Air Traffic Control Simulation Control aircraft at 11 included airports, issue voice commands, manage traffic, and work together in multiplayer in the most immersive air traffic control simulator available.

item.title: 007 First Light
item.description: Earn the Number. 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Follow James Bond as a young, resourceful and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training programme, and discover an origin story of the world’s most famous spy.

item.title: Hydroneer
item.description: Hydroneer is a mining and base building sandbox. Dig for gold and other resources to turn a profit and enhance your mining operation. Build a base of operations, forge weapons, go fishing, and dig deep!

item.title: MineMogul
item.description: Design and build a factory deep underground in this physics-based automation sandbox. Mine resources, buy machines and master the chaos as you become the ultimate Mine Mogul!

item.title: Not Quite Dead: Open World Survival
item.description: Open world zombie survival Coop game with base building, looting, crafting, vehicles, and exploration.

item.title: Unnamed Pogo Game
item.description: Trapped with friends in a surreal world, your only way out is to bounce your way to the top. Master brutal physics, survive impossible obstacles, and face the climb together in this unforgiving pogo-stick challenge. One bad landing is all it takes to lose it all. Can you reach the peak?

item.title: We Need More Humans!
item.description: Abduct everyone on Earth with your UFO! An incremental where you'll travel around the world, unlock upgrades, customise your ship, and not leave a single human behind.
